meta.selection_rule: variant with the higher mean validation AUC across seeds; weights from its run with the highest validation AUC
meta.threshold_rationale: Lowest threshold whose VALIDATION precision is still >= 0.85 (validation precision 0.859, recall 1.000). A missed flood costs lives while a false alarm costs an inspection, so recall is maximised subject to the precision floor. Chosen on validation data only.

seed_note: sample standard deviation (ddof=1) across seeds; accuracy, precision and recall use the default 0.5 threshold

confusion.note: rows = actual, columns = predicted, order no_flood then flood
